articles.title: A Moon of Uranus May Hide an Ocean 40 Times Deeper Than the Pacific
articles.summary: Scientists think Uranus' moon Ariel once had a hidden ocean over 100 miles deep. That's 40 times deeper than the Pacific Ocean! Cracks on its surface hint at this secret sea.

articles.title: Frogs Wear Invisible Bacteria Armor to Fight Deadly Fungus
articles.summary: Some frogs survive a deadly fungus thanks to bacteria living on their skin. Scientists found that when these bacteria are removed, the frogs get sick. It's like a natural suit of armor!

articles.title: When Humans Were Prey: Leopard Bites on an Ancient Jawbone
articles.summary: Nearly 2 million years ago, a leopard bit an early human's face. Scientists found tooth marks on a jawbone, showing our ancestors were once prey — not just hunters.
